title: KYA-OS Usergroup Builder Entry
description: One builder listing in the KYA-OS usergroup registry. Each entry lives at registry/builders/<slug>.json and the filename must equal the `slug` property. Structural validation is enforced by scripts/validate.mjs; keep that script and this schema in sync.

name.description: Display name of the builder or project.

slug.description: URL-safe identifier. Must match the entry filename: registry/builders/<slug>.json.

description.description: Short description of what this builder ships on KYA-OS (280 characters max).

categories.description: What kind of work this is.

kyaOsRepos.description: Which KYA-OS packages or specs this builder builds on (for example: kya-os-mcp, schema).

contact.description: How maintainers can reach you about this entry.

listedAt.description: Date the entry was added, YYYY-MM-DD.
